  <text x="66" y="244" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">This breakdown is incredibly clear — the new policy angle makes much more sense now.</text>

    <text x="80" y="334" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Agree, especially the part about the timeline. That was the missing context for me.</text>
